sources.title: Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6B-ONNX-INT4 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Audio8 TTS Preview is a .6B-parameter multilingual text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning. This repository provides its CPU-oriented ONNX deployment: weight-only INT4 DualAR models, an FP16 neural audio codec, the tokenizer, and the optional FP16 encoder used to register reference voices.
